name: Semmelweis University
description: Semmelweis University, located in Budapest, Hungary, is one of the leading medical universities in Central Europe, renowned for its excellence in medical education, research, and healthcare services. Established in 1769, Semmelweis University has a long-standing tradition of training medical professionals and conducting groundbreaking research to advance healthcare globally. With a commitment to innovation, collaboration, and patient-centered care, Semmelweis University prepares students to become compassionate and highly skilled healthcare professionals capable of addressing the complex health challenges of the 21st century.
